xercatools.knife_tooltip: Deals bonus damage with sneaky backstabs.
xercatools.knife_offhand_tooltip: Can stab in the offhand with right click.
xercatools.grappling_tooltip: Target a block to pull yourself there
xercatools.guillotine_tooltip: Hold right click to charge a guillotine strike
enchantment.xercatools.enchantment_poiso: Knife enchantment. Adds a poison effect on hit.
enchantment.xercatools.enchantment_steal: Knife enchantment. Increases backstab damage while sneaking behind the target.
enchantment.xercatools.enchantment_grapp: Grab hook enchantment. Allows you to target blocks and launch yourself towards the block as a grappling hook.
enchantment.xercatools.enchantment_turbo: Grab hook enchantment. Increases the speed and distance of the hook.
enchantment.xercatools.enchantment_gentl: Grab hook enchantment. Pulls the target without causing damage.
enchantment.xercatools.enchantment_guill: Scythe enchantment. Unlocks a charged right-click strike that can behead killed targets.
enchantment.xercatools.enchantment_devou: Scythe enchantment. On hit and on kill, releases life essence that heals the wielder.
enchantment.xercatools.enchantment_heavy: Warhammer enchantment. Increases the maximum pull time, but also adds more damage and knock back.
Warhammer enchantment. Cripples your opponent on hit, applying a Slow effect.
enchantment.xercatools.enchantment_quick: Warhammer enchantment. Lets you pull the hammer faster while hitting with the same power.
enchantment.xercatools.enchantment_quake: Warhammer enchantment. Allows you to target the ground. When you hit the ground, all mobs around the target point are damaged according to their proximity and knocked back from that point.
enchantment.xercatools.enchantment_upper: Warhammer enchantment. Adds a knock up component to the Warhammer, launching the target upwards.
enchantment.xercatools.enchantment_capac: Ender Flask and Potion Launcher enchantment. Increases the potion capacity.
enchantment.xercatools.enchantment_range: Potion Launcher enchantment. Increases range and projectile speed.
Ender Flask enchantment. Increases drinking speed.
